This is an EMPTY functional terrain plate; every functional building remains a separate overlay.

CORRECT only the demonstrated terrain defects:

Remove EVERY foreground retaining wall, black battlement wall, railing, banner pole, tent, crate and other solid obstacle from the immediate bottom 20% and from the narrow lanes where they block the foreground building doors in image2. Paint continuous walkable irregular dark cobbled street aprons to the bottom image edge, with subtle gutters/ground grain but NO vertical faces in front of door thresholds. Especially bottom-left barracks/front stair-foot, bottom center inn, bottom-center-right knife guild, and bottom-right forge must have CLEAR FLOOR on all land below their base.
2. The big bastion placed top-right (image2) has a cliff/void/drop underneath parts of its foundation. Remove that cliff, the cavern gap/viaduct background and the steep rubble slope directly under the bastion. Make the ENTIRE mid-right native area x635..799, y96..205 a LEVEL SUPPORTED DRY stone urban courtyard and connecting lane. No ground collapse, water or wall face under its full angled stone base or front staircase. Tiny water may remain ONLY the extreme far-right native 8 pixels at y155..203 for an optional dock, everything else dry. Do not draw an obvious rectangular platform; integrate the paving naturally with the surrounding street.

The correct regional emblems already exist as painted banners on the functional overlay buildings in image2 and must not be replaced or duplicated into this backdrop. Keep a few low braziers only in free unreserved street edges.
4. Remove the short decorative wall around the middle-right arena/front-door area and beneath the academy left, so all door aprons connect continuously to the existing curved central street. No vertical wall in front of any facade visible in image2. No new rows of structures or repeated rectangular pedestals.
5. Keep the foreground native area textured and DARK with warmer readable street edges; no bright fog or haze. Keep the rear SKYLINE distant and dramatically ominous Noxian red smoke; behind the empty sites it can be atmospheric but must not create big wall faces or buildings through functional silhouettes.

Use genuine painted2D original HeroesIII compact matte-painting surface treatment and 800x374 composition. No Blender/3D/vector/photorealistic camera/lens/modern render. No text, markup, guide colors or UI. Keep the exact canvas/ration. Output ONLY the corrected clean EMPTY TERRAIN background, without any functional buildings copied from image2. Door access and dry supported land are more important than retaining decorative walls.
